panels.title: Traffic by version
panels.description: During a canary this is the split actually being served, which is the first thing to check when a rollout does not look like the policy says it should.

panels.title: p99 latency by version
panels.description: Compared per version rather than per model on purpose: a canary that is slower than the incumbent is invisible in an aggregate that is still 90% incumbent traffic.

panels.title: Mean batch size
panels.description: A value near 1 means requests are arriving too slowly to group, so the batching window is adding latency and buying nothing.

targets.expr: sum by (model, version) (rate(modelforge_batch_size_sum[5m])) / sum by (model, version) (rate(modelforge_batch_size_count[5m]))

panels.title: Errors by reason
panels.description: Split by reason because 'overloaded' and 'unknown_feature' call for opposite responses: one is capacity, the other is a caller sending the wrong thing.

panels.title: Shadow comparisons
panels.description: How often the candidate agrees with what is being served. A rising 'diverged' rate is the signal to look at the candidate before promoting it.

panels.title: Feature drift (PSI)
panels.description: Population Stability Index per feature over the serving window. The thresholds drawn here are the conventional readings: 0.1 moderate, 0.25 significant.
